[Aguynamedlance] There's Two ways and it depends on you soda stream bottle type.
With Pink and blue bottles: A hose to connect the big bottle to the soda stream. Downside is that you need space for a big bottle.
With blue bottles: connect the soda stream bottle to the big bottle with a Filling Adaptor, turn it up side down, slowly open the cable until you can't hear it filling anymore. Downside is it take some practise and it's heavy (a 6kg bottle weighs about 20kg full)
Your local home brew shop should have everything, otherwise Kegland has everything.
You'll need to check where you can refill your big bottle to make sure you can get there. For me there's only one place within 100km. Kegland has a map.
For me it $50 to swap a 6kg bottle and that is equivalent to 13 soda stream bottles. Which makes it less than $5 a soda stream refill.
[dangerdanger] Do as per Aguynamedlance said, option 1.
I have a 2.6kg cylinder, piped direct to the Sodastream machine.
Did that years ago and love it. Lasts a year for me
